inspiration: Spell visuals are referenced by numeric ID from a table converted from client data (spellvisual_dbc.sql). The effects are not in the repo. Recreate as our own effect table: ID to particle preset.

A creature points to its display models through a separate weighted table with scale and probability (creature_template_model.sql). One creature can carry several looks. Build our own variant set with weights.
Creature templates link a base entry to difficulty-tier siblings (difficulty_entry columns). Show tiers with palette, glow and ornament rather than only a bigger model.

Map collision and navigation are baked offline from client data by extractor tools, then fed to a navmesh library (deps/recastnavigation). For us: bake navmeshes from our own level geometry as a build step; cross-link to zones and spawns.
Text lives in parallel locale tables next to the data tables, so copy can change without touching the rows. Good pattern for our text layer.
Item and gameobject templates are separate from their addon tables. Clean split of what a thing is from how it looks and behaves, which we can mirror.

briefs.label: Clockwork hatchling (own label)
briefs.why: A small mechanical flying companion. Reads as a toy-like machine with a living glow, a good contrast for the player's leather or mail look.
keep: a single glowing eye as the focal point
change: our own gear layout, no crest or dragon head
a bronze and teal palette instead of silver
wings made of folded plates, not membrane
briefs.ref: data/sql/base/db_world/creature_template.sql line 95 (row name only; no model in repo)

briefs.label: Field golem (own label)
briefs.why: A farm construct built from everyday materials. Warm, weathered and friendly; the silhouette sells the material story at a glance.
change: our own rig with a faceted glass core
stalk and sack materials drawn in our own style
a lantern or lamp in the chest instead of a face
briefs.ref: data/sql/base/db_world/creature_template.sql line 99 (row name only; no model in repo)

briefs.label: Cave crawler pack (own label)
briefs.why: A low, many-legged pack creature that works in groups. Its low silhouette makes it read well in a dark cave camera.
keep: many legs and a group behaviour
dark body with a few light points
change: crystal carapace with a bioluminescent underside
a clicking sound and dust trail of our own
briefs.ref: data/sql/base/db_world/creature_template.sql line 102 (row name only; no model in repo)

briefs.label: Appearance roll (own label)
briefs.why: One creature picks a look from several models with weights and a scale. Gives variety for crowds without new entries.
change: our own model set, not donor models
colour and marking variants on top of the model

briefs.label: Elite tier (own label)
briefs.why: The same creature has a harder sibling. Players learn to read the tier at a glance.
keep: tier linked to a base creature
stronger version of the same design
change: tier shown by a crown or glow, not a bigger model
palette shift on the same silhouette
our own tier names and ornaments
